DELIVERABLES:
1. ArrJson: shared kotlinx.serialization Json instance configured ignoreUnknownKeys=true, explicitNulls=false, coerceInputValues=true, encodeDefaults=true.
2. DefaultArrClientFactory implementing ArrClientFactory: per-server OkHttpClient cache, connect/read timeouts 20s, X-Api-Key header interceptor, optional basic auth, User-Agent HomelabArr/1.0 (android), HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy support WITH DNS resolved through the proxy (SOCKS: implement a resolver that resolves via the proxy or returns the hostname for remote resolution; HTTP: rely on CONNECT), proxy auth (ProxyPrincipal via authenticator).
3. Orbot integration: an OrbotDetector that checks package org.torproject.android presence via a pluggable PackageManager lambda (no direct android.content import in unit-tested classes; keep constructor-injected), and resolves useOrbot ProxyConfig to SOCKS5 127.0.0.1:9050.
4. TrustSpec handling: X509TrustManager variants for System, AcceptAny (per-server, log warning), Pinned (SHA-256 leaf fingerprint compare). Hostname verifier passthrough for pinned.
5. Normalization: exhaustively unit-test ServerEndpoint.normalizeBaseUrl for scheme addition, path prefix retention, trailing slash, port retention, ipv4 and ipv6 literals, cleanup of accidental spaces.
6. Error mapping: suspend extension okhttp3.Response.arrError() mapping 401/403 to ArrError.Auth, other non-2xx to ArrError.Http with body snippet, IO exceptions to ArrError.Network.
Unit-test everything testable on the JVM with MockWebServer (plain tests; trust/accept-any and pinning need not be fully covered, cover the branch logic).
